verdict.rationale: Auto-enrichment of contact and company records is a fair axis for a CRM like Pipedrive, but the evidence pack never mentions enrichment of firmographic or contact data. The 500+ tool integrations, workflow automation, and API are adjacent building blocks or third-party routes, not a documented first-party enrichment capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
